name: A New Cloak's Sheen
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Well met, champion. I've traveled with my companions down to the Feralas on a mission for our Orgrimmar masters.

My life-mate Korrin finds great pleasure in new clothing, so I aim to make her a new cloak adorned with the gossamer wings of faerie dragons. Would you be able to help me? Sprite darters with gorgeous wings I want are west of Camp Mojache.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Wonderful, Champion! These will do nicely. There are enough here to make a cloak for Korrin, and possibly even more! Thank you.

I hope the trip wasn't too dangerous? The area of Feralas is not known for being forgiving, but you've obviously done well enough.

Thank you again, Champion.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The sprite darters can be dangerous critters when provoked. Be careful when dealing with them, Champion. And be even more careful of any night elves in the area. The pestering fools tend to hold up in the forests also.

When you've gotten enough of the wings, let me know, I'll be sure to reward you well!
